review_evidence: README explicitly describes add-combi as a Lean theorem-prover library intended to cover additive combinatorics and built on Mathlib.
The hydrated snapshot has 14 Lean files with more than one hundred theorem/lemma declarations, rather than application or editor tooling.
AddCombi/BSG.lean alone develops a sequence of density/cardinality lemmas and claims toward Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers style arguments, providing directly reusable mathematical prior art.
summary: Retain add-combi as a substantive Lean library of additive-combinatorics definitions and proofs.

summary: Both files contain substantial formal mathematical content in additive combinatorics and should remain in the primary search index. AddCombi/Convolution/Finite/Order.lean proves order-theoretic properties of convolution and directed convolution (nonnegativity, support, positivity) with full Lean proofs. AddCombi/Mathlib/Combinatorics/Additive/Sidon.lean defines IsMulSidon/IsAddSidon predicates and proves core lemmas (monotonicity, empty/singleton/subsingleton cases, directed unions, pairs in torsion-free groups) using to_additive for the additive variant. Neither file is a pure import aggregator or documentation-only; both contribute unique definitions, statements, and proofs.
